commentary.title: Bank Indonesia Macro Commentary & Fixed Income Outlook
commentary.executiveSummary: Bank Indonesia maintains its stability-oriented monetary stance with the BI-Rate at 6.00%, supported by official JISDOR fixing at Rp 18,094 (5 November 2026) and spot USD/IDR at 18,088. 12M SRBI auctions cleared at a 6.601% weighted average accepted rate on IDR 41.81 T nominal bids, while 5Y IndoGB trades at 7.05% and 10Y FR0100 yields 7.18% (+228 bps over 10Y UST).

macroPillars.heading: Monetary & Liquidity Operations (SRBI Weighted Average Rates)
macroPillars.analysis: Bank Indonesia continues pro-market open market operations via SRBI auctions. As published on Bank Indonesia Operasi Moneter and CEIC Data, latest weighted average accepted rates cleared at 6.491% for 6M, 6.530% for 9M, and 6.601% for 12M (IDR 41.81 T nominal bids), preserving an orderly carry buffer and absorbing surplus banking reserves.

macroPillars.heading: Sovereign Debt Curve (IndoGB ~7% Benchmark Yields)
macroPillars.analysis: IndoGB yields reflect solid primary auction uptake and domestic institutional demand. As tracked on TradingEconomics (gidn5y:gov), the 5Y yield trades at 7.05% while the 10Y benchmark (FR0100) trades at 7.18%, establishing a steady +228 bps spread over US Treasuries.

macroPillars.heading: Currency Dynamics (JISDOR Rp 18,094 & Offshore NDF)
macroPillars.analysis: Bank Indonesia's official JISDOR reference rate fixed at Rp 18,094 per USD on 5 November 2026 (following Rp 18,140 on 4 November 2026). Offshore 1-Month NDFs trade at 18,153 (+65 IDR spread / 4.31% p.a. basis), while IDX Composite (IHSG) closed at 5,030.26 (+2.25%).
